well_controlled.clinical_note: Continue current regimen, reinforce adherence, reassess CGM in 3 months.
well_controlled.escalation_threshold: TIR drops below 65 OR new TBR>4 events

variable_controlled.clinical_note: Good average control but high swings. Address meal pacing, post-meal walks, possibly drug timing.

consistent_elevated.clinical_note: Stable but high. Likely needs intensification — basal/dose adjustment or adherence review.

high_risk_glucose.clinical_note: Worst combination — high average and high variability. Urgent regimen review.
high_risk_glucose.escalation_threshold: Always loop in clinician for new actions

moderate_mixed.criteria: Boundary case — within 1% of two thresholds
moderate_mixed.clinical_note: Boundary phenotype. Use driver decomposition to pick action.
